From: Marta Sanchez <marta.sanchez@greenbank.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: security@greenbank.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ — request & timeline

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our third-party intake we need a completed CAIQ mapping and a control-level evidence plan for Redwood Inference. Specifically we need:
- Completed CAIQ answers spreadsheet (CSV/XLSX) with short justification for non-standard entries
- Control ownership roster (who at Redwood owns each CSA control)
- Any existing sample artifacts (logs, runbook snippets, config snapshots) called out with locations or links

Timeline: our internal review kicks off on Oct 12; can we get an initial submission by Oct 6? If some controls require operator screenshots or longer collection windows, flag them and we'll triage.

Also: please confirm whether CAIQ responses will cover both Hosted API and Private (VPC) footprint — we scoped both in the intake.

Best,
Marta
Marta Sanchez
Senior Information Security Analyst
GreenBank

PS — attaching the GreenBank CAIQ template we prefer (sent separately).

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Sanchez <marta.sanchez@greenbank.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ — request & timeline

Marta — thanks for the clear ask. Confirming we can get an initial submission by Oct 6 with the caveat that a small set of runtime telemetry examples will need a 48-hour extraction window (we'll call those out). We will cover both Hosted API and Private (VPC) model in the same CAIQ workbook and annotate scope per-row.

Plan:
1) Attach initial CAIQ answers (v0.1) and control roster with owners (attached).
2) Priyom will own the runtime/telemetry controls and provide log snippets; Marissa will coordinate legal/procurement items and any DocuSign access for attestations.
3) If GreenBank prefers, we can schedule a 30-min walkthrough on Oct 7 to review high-risk controls.

Deliverables attached: redwood_caiq_initial_answers_v0.1.xlsx, control_ownership_roster_v1.csv

Would you like the walkthrough as a live call or a narrated recording?

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_caiq_initial_answers_v0.1.xlsx (xlsx, 1.2MB), control_ownership_roster_v1.csv (csv, 18KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Looping in a short execution plan (internal):

- Split CAIQ by control family: I will tackle Runtime & Logging (CSA: INF-*, LOG-*) and produce redacted log snippets. Expect two sample exports:
  * API request/response trace (prefix-kv cache expunge)
  * Model inference telemetry (latency/kv-hit rate)
- Marissa: please confirm which legal artifacts need to be attached to specific control rows (e.g., data processing addendum, SLA excerpt).
- Table column convention: CAIQ row, Redwood answer, justification (2-3 lines), artifact link (internal drive path), owner, ETA.

I will start on the Runtime controls this afternoon and push updates to the Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.internal/teams/gcs/GreenBank-CAIQ/initial-answers

Proposed walkthrough: Oct 7 10:00-10:30 PT (I'll share a calendar invite). If GreenBank would prefer a recording, we can produce a short 12-minute narrated walkthrough to attach with the workbook.

--Priyom
Senior Product Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Laura,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attached workbook. A couple of follow-ups from our intake team after a quick scan:
- Please flag any controls that reference customer-managed keys vs Redwood-managed KMS and provide the policy snippet or key rotation cadence.
- For data residency: we need a short assertion line per control indicating whether the control applies differently to requests routed to EU vs US regions.

Walkthrough sounds good — we'll take Oct 7 10:00 PT as proposed. Live call preferred so we can ask clarifying questions.

If you can add the KMS note to the relevant CAIQ rows and drop a link to the key rotation policy (or attach a redacted excerpt), that will help speed our review.

Thanks,
Marta
